text:
ellie: Quick sync — need to finalize webinar topic + abstracts by EOD Friday. Options: A) Cost-aware inference for product teams, B) Migration playbook to Dedicated/Private, C) Benchmarks that matter. Thoughts?
aj: leaning A — hits engineering & product buyers. short abstract needed.
mike: A + demo of Optimize tooling. we can show before/after cost numbers. :chart_with_downwards_trend: 
tara: B has legal/sales pull but harder to demo in 20m.
nina: C could be great as a panel format; invites external customers.
ben: suggest quick poll with leads list — pick 1 now, others as follow-ups. i'll run poll.
ellie: Thanks — let's also lock speakers. proposed: me (host), aj (product), mike (eng demo), nina (customer/PM). ok?
aj: yes. can confirm slides + 5 min talking points by Thurs.
mike: 20m demo slot needs 10-minute dry run. can we book green room Wed 10-11am?
tara: I'm out Wed AM — can we do Tue 4pm alternative?
ben: booked Tue 4pm for green room.
ellie: new run-of-show draft (20m total):
```
00:00-02:00 Intro + hook (ellie)
02:00-08:00 Market framing + thesis (aj)
08:00-16:00 Demo: Optimize + before/after (mike)
16:00-18:00 Customer case + quick Qs (nina)
18:00-20:00 Live Q&A + CTA (ellie)
```
ellie: Need slide counts: host intro (2), thesis (4), demo (6), customer (2), CTA (1). Can speakers share decks by Thurs EOD.
nina: I'll prepare customer 2 slides. sending notes to #assets link: https://drive.redwood/webinars/optimize
aj: Can we add a quick benchmark chart to thesis slides? mike will supply numbers.
mike: dropping numbers in shared sheet by EOD today. https://sheets.redwood/demo-data
sam: reminder: record + captions on. ops will start recording 10m before go-live.
ben: promo plan — email + twitter + partner shoutouts. need speaker headshots by Friday.
ellie: I'll collect headshots. also let's keep abstract concise for event page: one-line + 2-paragraph blurb. anyone want to draft?
aj: i'll take the 1-liner.
mike: i'll write demo paragraph.
tara: i'll do the customer paragraph.
ellie: perfect. final check-in Friday 9am. :tada:
